slides.headline: A client asked for 'one small extra'.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: Free extras become the new normal. Then the next one arrives.
slides.right_sub: Say yes with a price, or swap.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Check the deal
slides.card: Here is my agreement: [paste]. Is this request inside or outside it? Quote the lines.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Count the extra
slides.card: Estimate the extra work for this request in hours (low and high). List what it includes.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Draft 3 replies
slides.sub: Yes with a price, swap, or no
slides.card: Write 3 short replies: yes with a price, a swap, or a polite no. Friendly, firm.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Put it in writing
slides.card: Turn the chosen reply into a change note: what's added, price, new deadline. 5 lines max.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Update the brief
slides.card: Update the original brief with this change. Show only what changed, so I can send it.
slides.note: Not legal advice. Check your contract.

slides.headline: Save this for your next 'quick favor.'

scenes.title: THE PRE-MORTEM
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: It's 6 months from now and this plan failed. Plan: [your plan]. Give me the 5 most likely reasons, what I can do now about each, and which one I should test first.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Fix it before it costs you.

scenes.note: Comment below. Keep private data out of the prompt.
